cycle_definition: a thermal-triggered CHARGE departure, a physical off-contact interval, a later low-energy SEEK entry while off-contact, and a subsequent post-action physical charging-contact reacquisition; beacon strength alone never counts

ecology.post_contact_setup: body and station at (0.5, 0.5), seeded heading preserved

programmed.policy_rng: organism-owned policy stream derived from seed

seek_latency_definition: transitions_to_reacquisition is reacquisition transition index minus low-energy SEEK entry transition index; immediate entry action contact is latency 0
